text:
Noah: Quick heads-up 5min - after the Orbit ATS update this morning some interviewers submitted scorecards but the system shows the scale as 10 instead of 5, so panel averages are doubled for a handful of candidates (ENG-Platform panels).
Ivy: Wait what? How did the scale change? We didn't touch the rubric.
Noah: Looks like the client-side form was rendering the legacy scale for users who had not refreshed. They could submit on a 10-point scale and backend expects 5.
Samir: That would explain why a few candidate scores were way higher. Can we normalize by dividing by 2 for affected submissions? Need to be careful if someone legitimately used a 10-point rubric in notes.
Tess: We have two debriefs in 40m - what quick steps? We can't re-run interviews.
Priya: Short workaround: ask leads to confirm whether any interviewer used the old PDF (we still have the old PDF link in onboarding) vs the new inline form. If they used the PDF, we should treat their numeric inputs as 5-scale, otherwise convert. I'll open a tiny survey in candidate threads asking interviewers to confirm which scale they used.
Noah: Good call. Also the system allowed edits after submit for some roles (weird permissions bug), so values may have changed post-submit. Need to snapshot history before any reconciliation.
Samir: Ops note - event store has the pre-submit deltas. I'll extract the change history and attach to OPS-5067. We can compute which entries were submitted with scale=10 by looking at client_version in the payload.
Ivy: Can we add a blocking client-side snackbar telling users to refresh if they haven't in 24h? That might reduce confusion.
Priya: I'll schedule a short recorded micro-training: "ATS scoring scale & submit safeguards (10m)" and pin it to #hiring-resources. Also adding a required checkbox: "I confirm I used the 5-point rubric" before final submit for this quarter.
Tess: For the current candidates, we'll mark any auto-normalized scores in candidate notes and let hiring managers choose whether to include them in averages.
Noah: Thanks. Samir, ETA on export of pre-submit deltas?
Samir: Running extraction now, should have a CSV in ~1hr. I'll include client_version and timestamps so we can reliably detect 10->5 mismatches.
hiring-bot: Recorded micro-training "ATS scoring scale & submit safeguards (10m)" uploaded to #hiring-resources. RSVP optional. :record_button:
Priya: I'll also follow up with a quick doc update for interviewers and remove the legacy PDF from onboarding links until we confirm everyone migrated.
Ivy: Let's capture this as a process item: add a 'submit snapshot' server-side write that can't be edited without an explicit revert flow.
Noah: Filing post-incident note and owners in OPS-5067 (owner: Samir). Appreciate the quick triage teams.
